observations.body: Moses pitches the Tent outside camp; seekers go out, cloud descends, the people worship, and the LORD speaks with Moses face to face as with a friend.
observations.label: The tent outside the camp becomes a meeting place

observations.body: The tent outside the camp becomes a meeting place belongs to breach and intercession in the Sinai trail.
observations.label: Where this sits

observations.body: Exodus 33:7–11 supplies aftermath evidence for the event’s developing sequence.
observations.label: Within the Sinai event

observations.body: The calf, judgment, intercession, threatened absence, and restored presence remain one damaged sequence without being collapsed into an easy resolution.
observations.label: Reading boundary

payload.posture: Read Exodus 33:7–11 as its own source before carrying it into the wider Sinai trail.
payload.tension: The tent outside the camp becomes a meeting place belongs to the breach and intercession movement, but its part in the event must remain distinct from the surrounding speech, response, breach, and renewal.
payload.title: The tent outside the camp becomes a meeting place
